question: Question linked to image # 3 In relation to the suspected diagnosis you have established, what would be the most appropriate confirmation test?

options.opa: Determination of pulmonary capillary pressure, using a Swan-Ganz catheter.
options.opd: Determination of eosinophils in peripheral blood.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Bronchoalveolar lavage -> collection of fluid from the lungs -> analysis for cellular and biochemical content -> 80% CHAIN: Thoracic computed tomography (pulmonary arteries) -> imaging of the pulmonary arteries -> evaluation for abnormalities -> 85% CHAIN: Determination of eosinophils in peripheral blood -> blood test for eosinophil count -> assessment for elevated levels -> 80%
analysis: In the context of suspected diagnosis, the most appropriate confirmation test would be bronchoalveolar lavage to obtain a sample of fluid from the lungs for analysis.
